description:
This pre-solicitation notice serves as a synopsis and is posted in accordance with FAR subpart 5.2, Synopses of Proposed Contract Actions.  This is not a solicitation. Vendors shall not submit a quote until the solicitation is posted to www.SAM.gov.  

The Department of War Education Activity (DoWEA) has the following requirements: 

The Contractor shall provide commercial off-the-shelf, 100% digital courseware for students and teachers as well as related professional learning, and technical support for One course: Video Communications I. The instructional resources shall be based on research-based best practices shown to help students master the standards.
